summary_en: ADR-Net addresses spatially nonuniform degradation in photoacoustic microscopy by first detecting out-of-focus regions and then selectively enhancing only those regions. A U-Net-derived anomaly detector generates a degradation mask that guides a fully dense U-Net reconstruction module, preserving already focused structures while correcting blurred areas. The paper reports consistent gains over representative convolutional, transformer, GAN, and diffusion baselines, making it a direct computational contribution to photoacoustic image formation and enhancement.
